description: This Java class defines the 'FeaturePropertyModified' event, representing an event triggered after a property of a feature in an IoT device's 'thing' has been modified. It includes methods for construction, serialization/deserialization from JSON, and accessors for event data.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyModified
classes.description: Immutable event class representing a modification to a feature's property, with methods for construction, extracting data, serialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of FeaturePropertyModified with various argument sets, including JSON-based deserialization.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the event.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature associated with the event.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer of the modified property.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the new value of the modified property.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON value entity associated with the event for schema validation purposes.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Builds and returns the JSON pointer representing the resource path of the event, including feature id and property.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Serializes the event payload into a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate filters.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code for the event instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for object equality based on event fields.

methods.description: Type check helper for equals method.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event.
